package.name: mapping_utils
package.description:
Converts the B2's RoboSense (rslidar_sdk) XYZIRT PointCloud2 on /rslidar_points into the Velodyne XYZIRT layout consumed by FAST-LIO2 / FAST-LIVO2, published on /converted_rslidar_points: float32 `time` relative to the scan start, uint16 `ring`, float32 `intensity`, NaN points removed, and header.stamp rewritten from the RoboSense scan-END convention to the scan-START convention both mappers assume. Derived from the ROS 2 port of HViktorTsoi/rs_to_velodyne.
Also carries map_downsampler_node, which voxel-downsamples FAST-LIO's accumulated /Laser_map (pcl::PointXYZINormal, 48 B/pt) onto /downsampled_fastlio_map (pcl::PointXYZI, 32 B/pt) so a live coverage view can be streamed to Lichtblick over rosbridge, which the raw topic is far too large for.
And mapping_manager_node (Python), which owns a mapping session end to end: it starts and stops tmms_master's fast_lio.launch.py on request, names the output .pcd, saves it via /map_save on stop, and latches the static odom -> camera_init that anchors FAST-LIO's world frame to the robot's odometry.
